Rule.Name: Ensure OS root directory access is denied by default (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Access to OS root directory is not denied by default.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a Directory directive for "/" with "Require all denied".
Rule.Correction: echo "<Directory />" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo " Require all denied" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "</Directory>" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload
Rule.Verification: grep -q "<Directory />" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && grep -q "Require all denied" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure web content directories have proper access controls (Manual)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Access to web content is not properly restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Manually configure appropriate Directory directives with proper access controls for web content.
Rule.Correction: Manual review required; update <Directory> directives in /etc/apache2/apache2.conf or sites-available/*.conf with appropriate "Require" statements.

Rule.Name: Ensure AllowOverride is set to None for root directory (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: AllowOverride is not set to "None" for the OS root directory.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set AllowOverride to "None" for the root directory in the Apache configuration.
Rule.Correction: sed -i '/<Directory \/>/,/<\/Directory>/ s/AllowOverride .*/AllowOverride None/' /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure AllowOverride is set to None for all directories (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: One or more directories have AllowOverride enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set AllowOverride to "None" for all directories in the Apache configuration.
